lane_conclusion: No record can materialize into a base-case annual passenger input. T5 found a new, authoritative historical exact-OD benchmark: directional public-maritime-transport passenger movements for each sealed Galápagos route for January–June 2022. Because the source is a semester aggregate rather than monthly manifests and no current/full-year series is public, all three remain hold/benchmark_only and annual_one_way_pax stays null. T6 remains hard null: Ballestas visitor arrivals are not embarkations, and no exact-terminal Palomino boarding series was found. Peru route IDs remain null/unsealed; USD 30 remains benchmark-only; no geometry, economics, or partner claim is changed.
